summary: The FDA recall of Exenatide Injection, USP, 250 mcg/mL, lot AP250095A (manufactured by Amneal Pharmaceuticals) has been reported only in U.S. sources. No other national regulator, WHO, regional agency, or credible news outlet has issued a separate alert for this product or batch outside the United States.
